blogs.description: 网页变化监控怎么设置？本文说明如何定义监控对象、变化条件、检查周期和提醒格式，并用 AutoClaw 创建周期任务。
blogs.content: 返回博客 网页变化监控怎么设置？用 AutoClaw 定时检查更新并生成提醒 教程 作者：AutoClaw Team 2026年11月2日 网页变化监控怎么设置？本文说明如何定义监控对象、变化条件、检查周期和提醒格式，并用 AutoClaw 创建周期任务。 网页变化监控的核心，不是让 AI 不停刷新一个页面，而是先定义“哪个页面的哪部分，发生什么变化时，才需要通知我”。一个可执行的监控任务，只需要说清四件事：监控对象、变化条件、检查周期、结果发到哪里。 别先选工具，先写一张“监控卡” 很多网页监控任务失败，不是因为工具不会打开网页，而是“变化”的定义太模糊。页面上的广告、时间、推荐位和随机内容都可能变，如果只要求“有修改就提醒”，最后只会得到大量无效通知。 要写清的内容 不够好的写法 可执行的写法 监控对象 帮我看着这个网站 只检查价格页的套餐名、价格和权益表 变化条件 页面变了就告诉我 出现新套餐、价格数字变化或权益条目增删时提醒 检查周期 定期检查 每个工作日 09:30，按中国标准时间执行 输出与去向 有变化提醒我 只在有实质变化时，把变化前后对比发到指定对话 哪些网页适合做变化监控 价格和权益页。 可以监控套餐价格、试用额度、功能限制和计费单位。此类信息会影响采购与对比，变化后应保留日期和原始描述。 公告、更新日志和招标页。 可以检查是否出现新条目，再提取标题、发布日期和摘要，而不是比较整个页面的样式。 岗位、库存或名单类页面。 可以监控新增、下架或状态改变，但必须说清哪些字段是唯一识别项，避免同一条目因排序变化被误判为新内容。 政策、规则和帮助文档。 此类页面更适合监控具体条款或标题，并在发现变化后交由人工复核，不应让 AI 直接给出法律或合规结论。 用 AutoClaw 创建周期监控 AutoClaw 的定时任务可以在指定时间自动执行一次性提醒或周期工作，并把结果发送到选定的对话或 IM 渠道。创建时不需要手工写调度规则，直接在对话中说清执行时间、重复周期、具体动作和结果发送位置即可。 确定需要检查的页面与具体字段。 设定检查时间、重复周期和时区。 写清什么变化才算需要通知的实质变化。 指定输出格式和接收对话或 IM 渠道。 创建后先手动执行一次，检查数据源和结果格式。 一段可直接改的监控任务描述 每个工作日上午 9:30，按中国标准时间检查以下网页。只监控页面中的套餐名、价格、计费单位和核心权益。如果与上一次有实质变化，输出变化字段、变化前内容、变化后内容、检查时间和页面地址，并发到当前对话。广告、页脚、时间戳、推荐位和排版变化不要视为实质变化。如果页面无法访问或需要登录，说明失败原因，不要猜测当前内容。 一条好的提醒应该包含什么 监控结果不应只写“网页已更新”。真正能帮助决策的提醒，应该保留变化对象、新旧内容、检查时间、原始页面和人工待确认项。如果一次发生多处变化，可以按字段列出对比，再给一句不带推测的摘要。 字段 作用 检查时间 说明结果是在什么时间点发现的 变化前 / 变化后 让接收者能直接判断差异 页面地址 方便重新打开和人工复核 待确认项 区分已证实变化与无法判断的内容 如何减少误报和漏报 只比较稳定字段。 不要把整页 HTML、广告位或个性化推荐当作监控对象。价格、标题、状态和规则条款通常更稳定。 区分“无变化”与“检查失败”。 页面打不开、授权过期或页面结构改变时，不能记录为“没有更新”。应单独报告任务失败，避免用户误以为监控仍在正常运行。 给监控任务设置复查频率。 长期任务会受页面改版、登录状态和连接器授权影响。定期手动检查一次结果，不再需要的任务应及时暂停或删除，避免重复通知和额外消耗。 常见问题 网页变化监控怎么设置？ 先选定具体页面和字段，再说清变化条件、检查周期、时区和通知位置。创建后必须先手动运行一次，确认不会把广告、时间戳和样式改动误判为内容更新。 网页变化监控是实时的吗？ 不一定。定时检查只会在设定的周期内发现变化，不等于秒级实时监控。检查越频繁，需要的资源也越多，应根据业务时效性设置合理周期。 需要登录的网页可以监控吗？ 取决于页面权限、登录状态和可用连接方式。涉及个人账号、付费数据或内部系统时，应先确认授权和数据使用边界，不要把账号密码写进任务文本。 结论 网页变化监控不是一个“开启即完成”的功能，而是一个需要持续验收的周期任务。先把监控对象、变化条件、执行时间和通知格式说清，再让 AutoClaw 定时执行和汇总，才能得到可判断、可追溯、不骚扰的更新提醒。

blogs.description: Pull live data into published artifacts through MCP connectors, and use Claude Code with a screen reader in the new screen reader mode.
blogs.content: What's New Week 29 · July 13–17, 2026 Copy page Copy page Pull live data into published artifacts through MCP connectors, and use Claude Code with a screen reader in the new screen reader mode. Copy page Copy page Releases v2.1.207 → v2.1.212 2 features · July 13–17 Artifacts call your MCP connectors web A published artifact can now call MCP connectors each time someone views it, so a dashboard shows live data and can take actions on demand rather than a snapshot from the session that built it. Each call runs through the viewing account’s own connections, and viewers approve access before the page’s first connector call. This week also adds public sharing links, editor roles for shared editing on Team and Enterprise plans, and artifacts created from Claude Tag sessions. Name the connector and the data you want in your prompt: Claude Code Build a dashboard artifact of open pull requests that pulls the live list through my GitHub connector when the page loads. Pull live data with MCP connectors Screen reader mode CLI Screen reader mode replaces the visual terminal interface with plain, linear text: instead of boxes, spinners, and in-place redraws, Claude Code prints labeled lines that a screen reader such as VoiceOver or NVDA reads in order, so you can approve permissions and review output end to end. Turn it on per session with a flag, per shell with the CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER environment variable, or everywhere with the axScreenReader setting. Start a session in screen reader mode: terminal claude --ax-screen-reader Turn on screen reader mode Other wins /fork now copies your conversation into a new background session with its own row in claude agents while you keep working; the in-session forked subagent it used to launch is now /subtask Auto mode no longer needs the CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AUTO_MODE opt-in on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud’s Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry; administrators can turn it off with disableAutoMode MCP tool calls that run longer than two minutes now move to the background automatically so the session stays usable; tune or disable the threshold with CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_AUTO_BACKGROUND_MS New claude auto-mode reset restores the default auto-mode configuration, and --yes skips the confirmation prompt New corporate launcher support: CLAUDE_CODE_PROCESS_WRAPPER or the processWrapper setting runs the processes Claude Code starts from its own binary, such as the background service and agent view sessions, through a required wrapper executable vimInsertModeRemaps setting maps two-key insert-mode sequences such as jj to Escape in vim mode --forward-subagent-text and CLAUDE_CODE_FORWARD_SUBAGENT_TEXT include subagent text and thinking blocks in stream-json output Session-wide caps stop runaway loops: WebSearch calls and subagent spawns each default to 200, tunable with CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_WEB_SEARCHES_PER_SESSION and CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENTS_PER_SESSION ”Always allow” permission rules save at the repository root, so approvals granted in a git worktree persist across sessions and worktrees Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud’s Agent Platform, and Claude Platform on AWS now default to Claude Opus 4.8 The collapsed tool summary line shows a live elapsed-time counter, so long-running tool calls visibly tick instead of looking stuck Full changelog for v2.1.207–v2.1.212 → Was this page helpful? blogs.title: Week 28 · July 6–10, 2026 - Claude Code Docs
blogs.description: Browse external sites from the Desktop app's built-in browser, run a full setup checkup with /doctor, and pick up auto mode transcript protections and agent view upgrades.
blogs.content: What's New Week 28 · July 6–10, 2026 Copy page Copy page Browse external sites from the Desktop app’s built-in browser, run a full setup checkup with /doctor, and pick up auto mode transcript protections and agent view upgrades. Copy page Copy page Releases v2.1.202 → v2.1.206 2 features · July 6–10 In-app browser on Desktop Desktop Claude Code on desktop now has a built-in browser. Claude can pull up docs, designs, or any other site, and read, click through, and interact with pages the same way it does with your local dev server previews. The browser is sandboxed and configurable: you choose whether browsing sessions persist, and safety classifiers review actions on external sites. Browse external sites /doctor is a full setup checkup v2.1.205 /doctor now diagnoses issues and can fix them, instead of printing a read-only report. It checks installation health, finds unused skills, MCP servers, and plugins versus their context cost, deduplicates local CLAUDE.md files against checked-in ones, proposes trimming CLAUDE.md content Claude could derive from the codebase, and flags slow hooks. It reports findings first and asks for confirmation before changing anything. /checkup is its alias. Run a checkup from any session: Claude Code > /doctor All commands Other wins Auto mode now blocks tampering with session transcript files, and asks before running rm -rf on a variable it can’t resolve from context /cd now suggests directory paths as you type, matching /add-dir /commit-push-pr auto-allows git push to the repo’s configured push remote in addition to origin Gateway: /login now supports Anthropic-operated public gateway endpoints EnterWorktree asks for confirmation before entering a git worktree outside the project’s .claude/worktrees/ directory Background agents upgrade to a new version in the background right after a Claude Code update, instead of paying a slow stale-session upgrade when you attach Agent view rows now show a colored state word and a classifier-written headline instead of raw tool call text, and sessions that edit, merge, comment on, or push to an existing PR link it in claude agents Auto-update binary downloads now stream to disk instead of buffering in memory, cutting the updater’s peak memory usage by roughly 400 MB Background task notifications now explicitly state that no human input has occurred, preventing fabricated in-transcript approvals from being acted on Improved /code-review findings quality on Opus 4.8 across all effort levels Full changelog for v2.1.202–v2.1.206 → Was this page helpful? blogs.description: Authenticate MCP servers from your shell with claude mcp login, get a response to shell mode command output with the ! prefix, and resume a conversation from before /clear with /rewind.
blogs.content: What's New Week 26 · June 22–26, 2026 Copy page Copy page Authenticate MCP servers from your shell with claude mcp login, get a response to shell mode command output with the ! prefix, and resume a conversation from before /clear with /rewind. Copy page Copy page Releases v2.1.185 → v2.1.193 2 features · June 22–26 Authenticate MCP servers from the CLI v2.1.186 New claude mcp login <name> and claude mcp logout <name> commands authenticate a configured MCP server from your shell instead of the interactive /mcp menu. claude mcp login runs the server’s OAuth flow directly, and claude mcp logout clears the stored credentials. Run the OAuth flow for a configured server without opening a session: terminal claude mcp login sentry Authenticate from the command line Shell mode responds to command output v2.1.186 Commands you run with the ! prefix now get a response from Claude once the output lands in the transcript, so you can run ! npm test and get an explanation of the failures without a second prompt. The response costs the same as sending a normal prompt. To keep the earlier behavior, where the output is added to context without a response, set respondToBashCommands to false in settings.json . Run a command and get a response to its output: Claude Code > ! npm test Shell mode with the ! prefix Other wins /rewind can now resume a conversation from before /clear was run New sandbox.credentials setting blocks sandboxed commands from reading credential files and secret environment variables Org-configured model restrictions now apply to the model picker, --model , /model , and ANTHROPIC_MODEL , with a “restricted by your organization’s settings” message when a restricted model is selected New autoMode.classifyAllShell setting routes all Bash and PowerShell commands through the auto-mode classifier, and denial reasons now show in the transcript, the denial toast, and /permissions New claude_code.assistant_response OpenTelemetry log event carries the model’s response text; deployments that already log prompt content start receiving it on upgrade, so set OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES=0 to keep prompts only Background subagents now surface permission prompts in the main session instead of auto-denying; the dialog shows which agent is asking, and Esc denies only that tool /install-github-app can now install only the GitHub App and skip the Actions workflow and secret steps Hosts you allow in the sandbox network permission dialog are remembered for the rest of the session instead of re-prompting on every connection Streaming responses use about 37% less CPU, and long-session memory growth from the terminal output cache is reduced /review <pr> now uses the same review engine as /code-review medium Bash mode ! commands get live file path autocomplete Full changelog for v2.1.185–v2.1.193 → Was this page helpful? blogs.title: AI for Science expands to foundations and research institutions
blogs.author: Anthropic
blogs.description: We’re highlighting 20 scientific foundations, institutions, and research groups from around the world that we’ve partnered with in an expansion of our AI for Science program.
blogs.content: Chapter 01 : Science funders and societies AI for Science expands to foundations and research institutions Published Oct 28, 2026 Category Announcements Topics Discovery Research programs Partnerships Access Life sciences See more... Related articles Announcements Aug 27, 2026 Expanding our support for scientists View more We’re highlighting 20 scientific foundations, institutions, and research groups from around the world that we’ve partnered with in an expansion of our AI for Science program , which gives free Claude credits to researchers working on high-impact scientific projects. We started the AI for Science program in May 2025 with the belief that AI could significantly speed up scientific progress. Our goal is to increase access to AI tools and resources to enable researchers to deepen and expand their own scientific work. (Over the last few months, we’ve also launched our discounted Team plan for scientists and have supported hundreds of projects across biology, medicine, physics, chemistry, climate science, and mathematics.) Scientists have told us that they’re working with Claude to generate hypotheses, design experiments, swiftly analyze complex data, and communicate findings. With scientists at the center of this transformation, the field is setting the questions and developing the research projects that will help us tackle some of humanity’s toughest problems. Over the past year, we’ve started to expand this work and partner with scientific organizations to build collaborative research projects. For instance, we partnered with HHMI Janelia Research Campus to develop the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a shared specification that lets AI agents safely operate lab instruments. MHS is currently in research preview. We also support the Allen Institute , a leader in creating large open datasets and tools to advance research on the brain, cells, and the immune system. The institute is building teams of AI agents to analyze that data, turning months of manual analysis into hours. AI for Science began by supporting individual scientists. By partnering with institutions and foundations, we’re now able to reach more researchers across many fields. Many of these projects will also produce public goods that benefit the wider scientific community: open datasets, open-source software, open standards, and shared libraries. We look forward to seeing how AI resources can expand what scientists can attempt and lead to new discoveries. Science funders and societies Science funders and societies play an enormous role in finding and funding original, high-impact projects. We’re sharing Claude credits with the following organizations, which will distribute these resources to ambitious researchers aiming to use AI for scientific research: The Alfred P. Sloan Foundation. Founded in 1934, it supports original research and education in science, technology, engineering, mathematics, and economics. The Simons Foundation. This foundation advances the frontiers of research in mathematics and basic sciences through grants and its Flatiron Institute. Schmidt Sciences. Founded in 2024 by Eric and Wendy Schmidt, it works to accelerate scientific knowledge and breakthroughs with the most promising, advanced tools to support a thriving planet. The organization prioritizes research in areas poised for impact, including AI and advanced computing, astrophysics, biosciences, climate, and space—and supports researchers in a variety of disciplines through its science systems program. Open Source for Science Fund, a program of Renaissance Philanthropy. This is a time-bound philanthropic fund at Renaissance Philanthropy sustaining and evolving the open-source software stack that underpins science. The US National Science Foundation. This $9 billion federal agency established by Congress in 1950 promotes the progress of science, advances national health and defense, and funds competitive research and education, accounting for about 25% of federal support for

blogs.description: Publish a live, shareable page from your session with Artifacts, match tool parameters in deny and ask rules, and set any setting from the prompt with /config.
blogs.content: What's New Week 25 · June 15–19, 2026 Copy page Copy page Publish a live, shareable page from your session with Artifacts, match tool parameters in deny and ask rules, and set any setting from the prompt with /config. Copy page Copy page Releases v2.1.178 → v2.1.183 3 features · June 15–19 Artifacts An artifact is a live, interactive page that Claude Code publishes from your session to a private URL on claude.ai, and it updates in place as the session keeps working. Ask for one when terminal text is the wrong medium, such as a PR walkthrough with the diff annotated inline or a dashboard built from session data. Artifacts are in beta on Team and Enterprise plans. Ask Claude for a page, then approve the publish prompt: Claude Code Make an artifact that walks through this PR with the diff annotated inline. Create an artifact Match by input parameter v2.1.178 Deny and ask permission rules can now match a tool’s input parameters with the Tool(param:value) syntax. For example, Agent(model:opus) matches subagent spawns that request the Opus model tier. The value accepts * as a wildcard, so Agent(isolation:*) matches any explicit isolation value. Add a parameter rule to the deny list in settings.json : .claude/settings.json { "permissions" : { "deny" : [ "Agent(model:opus)" ] } } Match by input parameter Set any setting from the prompt v2.1.181 Pass key=value to /config to change a setting directly without opening the Settings interface. The syntax also works in non-interactive mode with the -p flag and from Remote Control. Set the thinking setting from the prompt: Claude Code /config thinking=false Commands reference Other wins Auto mode now blocks destructive git commands ( git reset --hard , git clean -fd , git stash drop ) when you didn’t ask to discard local work, and blocks terraform destroy unless you asked for the specific stack Set the new attribution.sessionUrl setting to false to omit the claude.ai session link from commits and PRs in web and Remote Control sessions In the /config interface, Enter and Space both change the selected setting, and Esc now saves and closes instead of reverting New sandbox.allowAppleEvents opt-in setting lets sandboxed commands send Apple Events on macOS Point CLAUDE_CLIENT_PRESENCE_FILE at a marker file to suppress mobile push notifications while you’re at the machine Long paragraphs now stream line by line instead of waiting for the first line break API connection drops mid-thinking now retry automatically instead of showing “Connection closed while thinking” With CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1 set, every session has one implicit team, so you spawn teammates directly with the Agent tool’s name parameter Skills in nested .claude/skills directories load when working on files there; on a name clash the nested skill appears as <dir>:<name> so both stay available Fixed prompt caching not reading on a custom ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and on Microsoft Foundry Fixed Write and Edit producing zero-byte or truncated files on network drives and cloud-synced folders Full changelog for v2.1.178–v2.1.183 → Was this page helpful? blogs.title: Expanding our partnership with GSA to bring Claude to all levels of government
blogs.author: Anthropic
blogs.description: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that's working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.
blogs.content: Expanding our partnership with GSA to bring Claude to all levels of government Published Oct 27, 2026 Category Partnerships Topics Government capacity Partnerships Access Claude for Enterprise Cybersecurity Claude Code See more... Related articles Partnerships Apr 24, 2026 Anthropic and NEC collaborate to build Japan’s largest AI engineering workforce View more We are expanding our partnership with the General Services Administration (GSA) through a new agreement that gives government partners a 40% discount on Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government, and the Claude API. For the first time, the discount applies across every product surface, including when agencies buy from us directly today and through cloud providers in the coming months. The discount also extends to state, local, tribal and territorial governments. We are also launching a dedicated program to help agencies implement and make the most of their Claude use. These programs are commonly leveraged by our private sector customers and we’re looking forward to bringing those best practices to our public sector partners in the coming weeks. Approximately 500 US federal, state, and local government organizations now use Claude. Weekly Claude for Government active users are up about eightfold since February, and usage across federal civilian agencies has grown about 20-fold in a year. Those organizations run some of the most important systems in the country, usually on tight budgets and with long procurement cycles. This agreement is built to support that work, so they can apply Claude to hard problems without a large upfront commitment. The discounts offered through the agreement are estimated to save the government $1 billion. Agencies are not bound by a minimum spend commitment and will be able to pay for the usage they consume. How Claude is helping public servants get more done Government agencies are using Claude to solve some of their most important challenges. Examples include managing backlogs, records and forms, and modernizing old code. Some of the ways agencies are using Claude include: Utah gave Claude Code to 34 developers across 10 state agencies. 80% had a working environment within 30 minutes, 71% reported saving 20+ hours by the end of the four-week pilot. A US state CIO confirmed their team was able to respond to a ransomware attack in 8 minutes vs. the usual 2-3 days thanks to Claude. A US federal security team used Claude Mythos to detect and patch the vulnerability that would have allowed for the takeover of a critical production system in about two days. A human penetration test the month before had missed it. A cybersecurity professional at a major agency found and patched bugs in critical financial systems. A US state IT developer moved nearly 900 API methods to a new framework in two days. The project had been scoped for a month. A US state IT director used Claude Code to document 12 legacy code repositories, mapping 467 database tables and flagging 27 risks along the way. More than half of the US states, some of the largest localities, and some of the countries largest critical infrastructure operators participated in our SLTT cyber defense program. Meeting government security requirements Agencies can use Claude for their most sensitive unclassified work. blogs.content: What's New Week 24 · June 8–12, 2026 Copy page Copy page Move a session to a new directory with /cd, let subagents spawn their own subagents, and troubleshoot a broken configuration with safe mode. Copy page Copy page Releases v2.1.166 → v2.1.176 3 features · June 8–12 Move a session with /cd v2.1.169 The new /cd command moves the current session to a different working directory without rebuilding the prompt cache: the new directory’s CLAUDE.md is appended as a message instead of replacing the system prompt. The session relocates to the new directory’s project storage, so --resume and --continue find it there. Claude prompts you to trust the directory if you haven’t worked in it before. Move the session into another project without restarting: Claude Code > /cd ../other-project Commands reference Subagents can spawn subagents v2.1.172 Subagents can now spawn their own subagents. The subagent panel below the prompt shows the full tree: each row carries a count of its descendants and a path back to main . Subagent chains are capped at five levels deep to prevent runaway concurrent trees. Open the agents view to watch the nested tree as work fans out: Claude Code > /agents Spawn nested subagents Troubleshoot with safe mode v2.1.169 Start Claude Code with --safe-mode , or set CLAUDE_CODE_SAFE_MODE , to launch with all customizations disabled: CLAUDE.md , skills, plugins, hooks, MCP servers, and custom commands and agents do not load. Authentication, model selection, built-in tools, and permissions still work. If a problem disappears in safe mode, one of those surfaces is the cause. Launch a clean session to isolate a broken configuration: terminal claude --safe-mode Test against a clean configuration Other wins fallbackModel configures up to three fallback models tried in order when the primary is overloaded or unavailable, and --fallback-model now applies to interactive sessions too Session titles are now generated in the language of your conversation; pin a specific one with the language setting claude agents --json adds --all to include completed sessions plus new id and state fields, and no longer omits blocked or newly dispatched sessions Browsing a marketplace’s plugins in /plugin now has a search bar New disableBundledSkills setting and CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS hide bundled skills, workflows, and built-in commands from the model Deny rules accept a glob in the tool-name position, so ”*” denies all tools, and unknown tool names in deny rules now warn at startup Agent messaging is hardened: messages relayed via SendMessage from other agents no longer carry user authority, and auto mode blocks them Amazon Bedrock reads the AWS region from ~/.aws config files when AWS_REGION is unset, and /status shows where the region came from New enforceAvailableModels managed setting makes the availableModels allowlist also constrain the Default model Claude in Chrome browser tools now load in a single batched call instead of one per tool claude update announces the target version before downloading instead of going silent New footerLinksRegexes setting adds regex-matched link badges to the footer row Full changelog for v2.1.166–v2.1.176 → Was this page helpful? blogs.content: What's New Week 23 · June 1–5, 2026 Copy page Copy page Run auto mode on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud’s Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry, prompt before writing files that can run code in acceptEdits mode, list installed plugins with /plugin list, and require an approved version range for managed deployments. Copy page Copy page Releases v2.1.158 → v2.1.165 4 features · June 1–5 Auto mode on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud’s Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry v2.1.158 Auto mode is now available on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud’s Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry for Opus 4.7 and Opus 4.8, replacing permission prompts with background safety checks on third-party providers. Opt in by setting CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AUTO_MODE=1 . Opt in on a third-party provider, then cycle to auto mode with Shift+Tab: terminal export CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AUTO_MODE = 1 Auto mode on third-party providers Safer automatic edits v2.1.160 Claude Code now prompts before writing files that can run code, even in acceptEdits mode. The protected set covers shell startup files such as .zshenv and .bash_login , git config under ~/.config/git/ , and build-tool configs such as .npmrc , .bazelrc , and .pre-commit-config.yaml . These writes are never auto-approved in any mode except bypassPermissions . Work in acceptEdits mode; Claude now pauses before writing these files: terminal claude --permission-mode acceptEdits Protected paths List installed plugins with /plugin list v2.1.163 The new /plugin list command prints your installed plugins inline, without opening the /plugin menu, and is also available as claude plugin list from the shell. In the interactive form, add --enabled or --disabled to show only plugins in that state. List the plugins that are currently turned on: Claude Code > /plugin list --enabled Plugin commands Version requirements for managed deployments v2.1.163 Two managed settings, requiredMinimumVersion and requiredMaximumVersion , let your organization require an approved Claude Code version range. A client outside the range exits at startup and tells the user to update through the organization’s method. claude update , claude install , and claude doctor keep working so users can still recover. Add a floor to your managed settings so older clients refuse to start: managed-settings.json { "requiredMinimumVersion" : "2.1.163" } Decide what to enforce Other wins The trigger keyword for dynamic workflows changed from workflow to ultracode ; asking for a workflow in your own words still works, and the keyword is highlighted in violet in the prompt Stop and SubagentStop hooks can return hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext to give Claude feedback and keep the turn going instead of being treated as an error claude mcp list, get, and add no longer print secrets: environment-variable references are not expanded, and credential headers and URL secrets are redacted A failed Bash command in a parallel tool batch no longer cancels the others; each tool returns its own result independently Editing a file no longer needs a separate Read first when you viewed it with a single-file grep , egrep , or fgrep Clicking a command in the autocomplete menu now fills it into your prompt instead of running it immediately; press Enter to run Listing Grep or Glob in --tools now provides the dedicated search tools on native builds with embedded search, instead of silently ignoring those names /effort now confirms when your chosen level will persist as the default for new sessions OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES values are now attached as labels on metric datapoints, so you can slice usage metrics by custom dimensions like team or repo Windsurf is renamed to Devin Desktop in /ide , /terminal-setup , and /scroll-speed , following the editor’s rebrand /btw gains a c to copy shortcut that copies the raw markdown answer to the clipboard Full changelog for v2.1.158–v2.1.165 → Was this page helpful? blogs.title: AI 生成 3D 模型网页怎么做？AutoClaw 可拆解镜头
blogs.author: AutoClaw Team
blogs.description: AI 生成 3D 模型网页怎么做？本文用可拆解镜头案例，说明 AutoClaw 如何实现光圈滑块、爆炸图、剖面图和光线演示，并交付源码与 HTML。
blogs.content: 返回博客 AI 生成 3D 模型网页怎么做？AutoClaw 可拆解镜头 教程 作者：AutoClaw Team 2026年10月31日 AI 生成 3D 模型网页怎么做？本文用可拆解镜头案例，说明 AutoClaw 如何实现光圈滑块、爆炸图、剖面图和光线演示，并交付源码与 HTML。 AI 生成 3D 模型网页，不只是将一张图变成“看起来立体”的画面。对教学、科普和产品讲解来说，真正有价值的是用户能够旋转模型、改变参数、拆开部件，并看到操作如何影响结构。只要把装置结构、要演示的变量和交互方式说清楚，AutoClaw 可以从需求拆解、代码实现一直推进到可运行的网页交付物。 先定义“要讲清什么” 三维网页最容易出现的问题，是模型看起来很复杂，但用户不知道自己要观察什么。因此需求应该先回答三个问题：哪些部件必须被看到，用户能够操作哪些参数，每次操作应该导致什么可观察变化。 这次镜头案例的学习目标很清楚：观察镜筒、镜片和六叶片光圈的相对位置；调节光圈，看到叶片和开口同步变化；再通过爆炸图和剖面图理解内部结构。这些目标比“做一个酷炫的 3D 镜头”更容易被实现和验收。 这次给 AutoClaw 什么 输入指定了一个完整可运行的 React 与 TypeScript 网页应用，镜头和六叶片光圈需要通过代码生成，不使用预制 3D 模型或预渲染动画。可见控件包括光圈滑块、旋转查看、爆炸视图、剖面视图和光线演示。 Build a complete, runnable React and TypeScript web app featuring an interactive 3D camera lens. Model the lens and a six-blade iris procedurally in code. Add an aperture slider, orbit controls, an exploded view, a cross-section view and visible light rays. All parts must remain aligned when switching views. AutoClaw 做了什么 它先把任务拆成模型、状态和视图三部分。模型层生成镜筒、镜片和六片重叠光圈叶片；状态层让光圈滑块与叶片位置联动；视图层负责默认工作台、爆炸图和剖面图之间的切换。用户将滑块从 f/1.7 调到 f/22 时，六片叶片向内合拢，开口随之缩小。 最终交付了什么 本次交付包含一套 React 18 与 TypeScript 项目 ，以及一个约 731 KB 的单文件 HTML 演示版。项目文件适合后续继续开发，单文件版适合快速打开展示。已有功能包括 f/1.7 至 f/22 的光圈调节、六叶片光圈、Studio、Exploded 和 Section 三种视图，以及光线路径。 怎么复用到其他 3D 交互讲解 这种方法不只适合镜头。发动机、工业设备、人体器官、建筑构件和产品爆炸图都可以用类似方式。输入时请分别说明：必须出现的部件，部件之间的关系，用户可以操作的参数，参数变化后的视觉结果，以及需要交付源码还是单文件演示版。 如果要做教学用途，还可以继续让 AutoClaw 增加指引顺序、中文标注和练习题。不过这些是后续可扩展的需求，不应写成本次成品已经具备的功能。 发布前需要人工检查 首先检查模型的结构是否足够支撑讲解目标，特别是爆炸和复位后的位置是否一致。然后逐个操作滑块和视图按钮，确认数值、叶片和画面反馈同步。最后在不同屏幕上测试拖拽、触摸、文字遮挡和加载性能。对专业教学内容，结构名称和科学说明还应由领域人员审核。 常见问题 AI 生成 3D 模型网页需要提供 3D 模型吗？ 不一定。结构较规则的对象可以通过代码生成；追求高精度外形时，提供已授权模型通常更合适。重点是先说清精度和用途。 3D 交互网页适合哪些场景？ 适合用平面图难以解释的空间关系、部件层次和参数变化。如果用户只需要查看文字和图片，普通图文网页反而更轻。

blogs.author: Anthropic
blogs.description: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that's working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.
blogs.content: Donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation Published Oct 22, 2026 Category Product Topics Agent Skills Open source Partnerships Agents See more... Related articles Product Jul 14, 2026 Introducing Claude for Teachers View more Today, we’re donating Agent Skills , the open standard that gives AI agents specialized knowledge and workflows, to the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF). More than 70 agent platforms, including ChatGPT, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and VS Code, have integrated Agent Skills since we published the standard in December 2025. Agent interoperability through simplicity A skill is a folder containing a SKILL.md file that teaches an agent a specific task or domain, along with any scripts or reference material it needs. We developed skills while working on Claude Code. It handled general knowledge work well, but often lacked the procedural knowledge that real business tasks need. Within weeks of our October 2025 launch, developers published thousands of skills on GitHub and wrote loaders for Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode. We then published Agent Skills as an open standard, under its own GitHub organization and domain, so any agent could use it. So far, 1 million skills have been published and nearly 280 million installed. Donating Agent Skills to AAIF We’re committed to keeping Agent Skills open, community-driven, and vendor-neutral. Today, we are donating the standard to the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF) under the Linux Foundation, which we co-founded with Block and OpenAI last year, and to which we donated the Model Context Protocol (MCP). The AAIF will provide a neutral home to the standard going forward, ensuring the community has a say in where Agent Skills go next. We are donating the Agent Skills name and logo, the GitHub organization, and the agentskills.io domain. You can continue to use the standard or contribute to it without joining the AAIF. Engineers from Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, and other companies will maintain the standard as individuals, with David Soria Parra and Mahesh Murag as Lead Maintainers. What comes next We’ve proposed starting with a roadmap covering versioned releases, a formal proposal process, and security guidance for people who write and install skills. As with MCP, the project will continue to prioritize community input and transparent decision-making. You can join the project’s Discord to give feedback on proposed specification changes. Thank you to the developers who built with Agent Skills from the start, and to the teams who brought skills into their products. Read the specification at agentskills.io and join the discussion on GitHub .

blogs.author: Anthropic
blogs.description: Today, we’re inviting members of the life sciences community to apply to work with us on special projects.
blogs.content: Open call for guest investigators in the life sciences Published Oct 22, 2026 Category Announcements Topics Life sciences Related articles Sep 23, 2026 Claude discovers a novel enzyme system with CRISPR-like repeats View more Today, we’re inviting members of the life sciences community to apply to work with us on special projects. We’re looking for proposals from principal investigators and their research groups at academic institutions, nonprofits, or government labs who want to use Claude to investigate key questions in causal human biology, structural and computational molecular biology, medicinal chemistry, drug discovery, and clinical science. You can submit a proposal for a project here . Over 8–12 weeks, guest investigators will work directly with Anthropic researchers on a problem of interest and produce the analyses, artifacts, and tools that will be most helpful for them in their work. Our team will run our models and harnesses at no cost to them. We’ll work together to publish these outputs and open-source the accompanying data and code. Guest investigators retain the rights to their data at every step during their project. They will also have the rights to any independent follow-on research that might come out of our collaboration. We’re looking for applicants who can clearly explain how they would benefit from direct collaboration with Anthropic’s researchers. Applicants should also make a reasonable case that their outputs (e.g., preliminary discoveries, answers to open questions, open-source datasets, or public resources) can be produced within the 8- to 12-week collaboration period. There may be an option for extension beyond the initial collaboration period for some projects. We understand that the results for most open problems of interest will take much longer to validate, but we’re looking for proposals that can produce some preliminary evidence in a relatively short amount of time. We aren’t asking for guest investigators to give us their data, either in the application or during the collaboration, and we’re requesting that applicants include only publicly available information in their application materials. Applications will be open for approximately 14 days, and we’ll strive to notify selected participants by email approximately 14 days after applications close. We look forward to potentially expanding this effort in the future as we learn more about how we can best support the scientific community. This program is one of several initiatives Anthropic is pursuing to invest more heavily in the life sciences and the broader scientific research community. Scientists who would like direct access to our most capable publicly available models for biology can apply to join our Life Sciences Verification Program . We’ve also continued to support researchers through our AI for Science initiative , which provides scientists with Claude credits to accelerate their progress toward making scientific discoveries.

Copy page Copy page Releases v2.1.143 → v2.1.149 1 feature · May 18–22 Auto mode on the Pro plan CLI Auto mode is now available on the Pro plan and supports Sonnet 4.6 alongside Opus. It replaces permission prompts with background safety checks: routine actions run without interrupting you, and destructive or suspicious ones are blocked and surfaced. Update Claude Code, then cycle modes with Shift+Tab; auto mode appears in the cycle once your account meets the requirements: terminal claude update The command prints Successfully updated with the new version number, or Claude Code is up to date if no update is needed. Once auto mode is active, the prompt footer shows auto mode on . Auto mode requirements Other wins /usage now shows a per-category breakdown of what’s driving your plan limits, attributing recent usage to skills, subagents, plugins, and individual MCP servers ”Extra usage” is renamed to “usage credits” across the CLI, and /extra-usage is now /usage-credits . The old name still works. The command requires signing in with your claude.ai subscription through /login and isn’t available with API key authentication. New /code-review command reports correctness bugs at a chosen effort level such as /code-review high , and --comment posts findings as inline GitHub PR comments. /simplify remains as a separate cleanup-only review. Background sessions now appear in /resume alongside interactive ones, marked with bg , and sessions pinned with Ctrl+T in claude agents stay alive when idle claude agents --json lists live sessions as JSON for scripting, such as status bars and session pickers The PowerShell tool is now enabled by default on Windows for Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud’s Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry users; opt out with CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL=0 claude plugin disable now refuses when another enabled plugin depends on the target, and claude plugin enable force-enables transitive dependencies The /plugin marketplace browse pane shows projected context cost, and the Discover and Browse screens list a plugin’s commands, agents, skills, hooks, and MCP/LSP servers before installation New worktree.bgIsolation: “none” setting lets background sessions edit the working copy directly without EnterWorktree , for repos where worktrees are impractical Markdown output renders GFM task list checkboxes, and the /diff detail view scrolls with the keyboard Status line JSON input now includes GitHub repo and PR information when detected Enterprise: the allowAllClaudeAiMcps managed setting loads claude.ai cloud MCP connectors alongside managed-mcp.json Full changelog for v2.1.143–v2.1.149 → Was this page helpful? blogs.title: AI 生成品牌网站怎么做？AutoClaw 护肤营销单页
blogs.author: AutoClaw Team
blogs.description: AI 生成品牌网站怎么做？本文通过护肤产品营销单页，说明如何给 AutoClaw 品牌资料、产品结构和视觉要求，并交付可预览 HTML。
blogs.content: 返回博客 AI 生成品牌网站怎么做？AutoClaw 护肤营销单页 教程 作者：AutoClaw Team 2026年10月30日 AI 生成品牌网站怎么做？本文通过护肤产品营销单页，说明如何给 AutoClaw 品牌资料、产品结构和视觉要求，并交付可预览 HTML。 AI 生成品牌网站时，最需要解决的不是“页面够不够炫”，而是用户能不能快速认识品牌、理解产品区别，并知道下一步可以做什么。如果品牌已经有产品线、价格和视觉方向，可以让 AutoClaw 把这些资料组织成一页式营销网站，并交付可直接预览的 HTML 成品。 品牌营销单页和电商网站不是一回事 营销单页主要承担品牌展示和产品解释：首屏给出定位，中段展示产品线和组合，后段用图片与问答补充信息。它可以包含“了解产品”或“选择套装”的按钮，却不等于已经完成购物车、库存、支付和订单管理。 这个区别很重要。如果需求只写“做一个护肤品牌网站”，最后很可能得到一张好看的视觉稿，但无法直接承接交易。因此第一轮就应该说清：这次要做品牌展示，还是要接入真实销售流程。 这次给 AutoClaw 什么 本次需求指定了一页式结构和明确的视觉语言：冷灰色首屏、深森林绿四列产品区、暖白色套装区，再用大圆角进行区块过渡。产品展示需包含瓶身、配方编号、容量、价格和按钮，并用高亮标签表达新品或套装信息。 Create a high-end one-page skincare website blending clinical science with organic minimalism. Use a cool grey hero section, a deep forest green four-column product grid, a warm off-white bundle section, pill-shaped CTAs, formula badges and a Bento gallery at the bottom. AutoClaw 做了什么 它先把页面分成几个阅读阶段：品牌首屏、单品对比、套装推荐和图片画廊。然后统一瓶型、标签、字号和按钮样式，让四款产品可以在同一视线内对比。页面从深绿转向暖白时，用大圆角分隔，避免长页看起来只是多个模块的拼接。 最终交付了什么 最终成品是一个 单文件 HTML 品牌营销页 。实际下载文件大小为 1,261,466 字节，约 1.2 MB。用户可以从首屏向下浏览品牌介绍、四款产品、套装区与画廊。这份交付物适合确认视觉方向、内容层级和按钮布局，但不应被描述为已经完成的电商系统。 怎么用 AutoClaw 做自己的品牌网站 先准备可确认的品牌资料：品牌定位、Logo 与标准色、产品图、产品名称、规格、价格、套装关系以及想让用户完成的动作。然后向 AutoClaw 说清页面顺序和每个区块的任务，不要只给一串风格形容词。 第一版完成后，可以在同一任务中继续要求：替换成真实品牌名和产品图；按重要性调整产品顺序；给套装补充包含内容；为手机端减少单屏文字。如果页面需要真实销售，再进入第二阶段，明确商品、购物车、支付和订单的系统连接。 上线前必须人工确认 护肤产品的成分、功效、适用人群和比较性表述应由品牌方审核，不能直接把生成文案当作可发布的专业结论。同时检查产品名、容量、价格、促销标签和图片授权。如果页面包含表单或购买按钮，还要逐个点击，确认手机端、不同浏览器和异常情况下的表现。 常见问题 AI 生成的网站可以直接上线吗？ 可以先作为可运行的视觉原型，但正式上线前还要核对文案、素材授权、移动端布局、按钮跳转、表单和隐私信息。有交易需求时，必须补齐后台和支付链路。 产品营销单页要放多少款产品？ 优先展示用户能够理解差异的核心产品。如果产品过多，首页可以只展示系列和主推款，再把具体信息分流到产品详情页。

blogs.description: Manage every Claude Code session from one screen with agent view, keep Claude working toward a goal until a condition holds, and run fast mode on Opus 4.7 by default.
blogs.content: What's New Week 20 · May 11–15, 2026 Copy page Copy page Manage every Claude Code session from one screen with agent view, keep Claude working toward a goal until a condition holds, and run fast mode on Opus 4.7 by default. Copy page Copy page Releases v2.1.139 → v2.1.142 3 features · May 11–15 Agent view research preview claude agents opens one screen for every Claude Code session: what’s running, what’s blocked on your input, and what’s done. Dispatch a bug fix, a pull request review, and a flaky-test investigation as three rows, keep working in another window, and step in only when a row needs you. Attach to any row to drop into its full conversation, then press ← to return to the list. Each background session keeps running without a terminal attached. Open the dashboard from your shell: terminal claude agents Agent view /goal v2.1.139 Set a completion condition and Claude keeps working toward it across turns without you prompting each step. After every turn, a fast model checks whether the condition holds; if not, Claude starts another turn instead of handing control back. Useful for substantial work with a verifiable end state, like migrating a module until every call site compiles and tests pass. The goal clears once the condition is met, and works in interactive, -p , and Remote Control. Set a goal and let Claude run until it holds: Claude Code > /goal all tests in test/auth pass and the lint step is clean Goals Fast mode on Opus 4.7 research preview /fast now runs on Opus 4.7 by default instead of Opus 4.6. Fast mode is a high-speed Opus configuration: the same model quality at about 2.5x the speed for a higher per-token cost, useful for rapid iteration and live debugging. Pricing is unchanged at $30/$150 per MTok, the same as Opus 4.6 fast mode. To pin fast mode to Opus 4.6, set CLAUDE_CODE_OPUS_4_6_FAST_MODE_OVERRIDE=1 . Toggle fast mode, now running on Opus 4.7: Claude Code > /fast Fast mode on Opus 4.7 Other wins claude agents gained dispatch flags ( --add-dir , --settings , --mcp-config , --plugin-dir , --permission-mode , --model , --effort , --dangerously-skip-permissions ) to configure background sessions, and claude agents --cwd <path> scopes the session list to a directory New hook args: string[] exec form spawns the command directly without a shell, so path placeholders never need quoting New continueOnBlock config option for PostToolUse hooks feeds the hook’s rejection reason back to Claude and continues the turn instead of ending it New terminalSequence field in hook JSON output lets hooks emit desktop notifications, window titles, and bells without a controlling terminal The Rewind menu added “Summarize up to here” to compress earlier context while keeping recent turns intact Remote Control, /schedule , claude.ai MCP connectors, and notification preferences are now disabled when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY , apiKeyHelper , or ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN is set, even alongside a claude.ai login; unset the API key to use these features MCP stdio servers now receive CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR in their environment, matching hooks, and plugin configs can reference $ CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR in commands claude plugin details <name> shows a plugin’s component inventory and projected per-session token cost, and the /plugin details pane now also lists the LSP servers a plugin provides Plugins with a root-level SKILL.md and no skills/ subdirectory are now surfaced as a skill /feedback can now include recent sessions from the last 24 hours or 7 days for issues spanning more than the current session Agent tool subagent_type now matches case- and separator-insensitively, so “Code Reviewer” resolves to code-reviewer Full changelog for v2.1.139–v2.1.142 → Was this page helpful? blogs.content: What's New Week 19 · May 4–8, 2026 Copy page Copy page Load plugins from .zip archives and URLs, search command history across every project with Ctrl+R, branch new worktrees from local HEAD or the remote default, and block actions unconditionally with auto mode hard deny rules. Copy page Copy page Releases v2.1.128 → v2.1.136 2 features · May 4–8 Plugins from .zip archives and URLs --plugin-dir now accepts a .zip plugin archive in addition to a directory, and the new --plugin-url flag fetches a plugin archive from a URL for the current session. Useful for trying a plugin before adding it to a marketplace, or for shipping internal plugins from an artifact store. Load a plugin straight from a URL: terminal claude --plugin-url https://example.com/my-plugin.zip Plugins guide History search across all your projects v2.1.129 Ctrl+R reverse-search now defaults to all prompts across every project, restoring the behavior from before v2.1.124. Press Ctrl+S while searching to narrow back to the current project or session. Handy when you remember a command you ran in another repo last week and don’t want to go digging for it. Interactive mode: command history Other wins New worktree.baseRef setting ( fresh | head ) controls whether --worktree , the EnterWorktree tool, and agent-isolation worktrees branch from the remote default branch or local HEAD ; the default fresh keeps unpushed commits out of new worktrees New settings.autoMode.hard_deny rules block matching actions unconditionally in auto mode, regardless of allow exceptions, for actions that should never run automatically even when broader allow rules apply Hooks now receive the active effort level via the effort.level JSON input field and the $CLAUDE_EFFORT environment variable, and Bash tool commands can read $CLAUDE_EFFORT CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ALTERNATE_SCREEN=1 opts out of the fullscreen alternate-screen renderer and keeps the conversation in the terminal’s native scrollback CLAUDE_CODE_PACKAGE_MANAGER_AUTO_UPDATE lets Homebrew or WinGet installations run the upgrade in the background and prompt to restart CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID is now in the Bash tool subprocess environment, matching the session_id passed to hooks /mcp now shows the tool count for connected servers and flags servers that connected with 0 tools --channels now works with console (API key) authentication Subprocesses such as Bash, hooks, MCP, and LSP no longer inherit OTEL_* environment variables, so OTEL-instrumented apps run via the Bash tool no longer pick up the CLI’s own OTLP endpoint Sub-agent progress summaries now hit the prompt cache, cutting cache_creation token cost by roughly 3x Several OAuth and credential reliability fixes: parallel sessions no longer dead-end at 401 after a refresh-token race, MCP OAuth refresh tokens are no longer lost when multiple servers refresh concurrently, and a rare login loop from a concurrent credential write is fixed New parentSettingsBehavior admin key lets admins opt SDK managedSettings into the policy merge Full changelog for v2.1.128–v2.1.136 → Was this page helpful? blogs.title: 室内设计公司介绍怎么做？用 AutoClaw 生成作品集式演示稿
blogs.author: AutoClaw Team
blogs.description: 室内设计公司介绍怎么做？本文从页面结构、案例顺序和素材准备入手，展示 AutoClaw 如何把需求和图片组织成作品集式演示稿。
blogs.content: 返回博客 室内设计公司介绍怎么做？用 AutoClaw 生成作品集式演示稿 教程 作者：AutoClaw Team 2026年10月30日 室内设计公司介绍怎么做？本文从页面结构、案例顺序和素材准备入手，展示 AutoClaw 如何把需求和图片组织成作品集式演示稿。 室内设计公司介绍的任务，不是把“公司简介、团队、案例、联系方式”依次堆在 PPT 里，而是用有顺序的页面让客户看懂：你们擅长什么，做过哪类空间，对材料、光线和细节有什么判断。把工作室信息、项目照片和目标客户交给 AutoClaw，它可以先组织叙事，再生成一份可展示的介绍稿。 室内设计公司介绍应该讲什么 一份给潜在客户看的介绍稿，至少要回答四件事：工作室的定位，项目中的思考方式，真实作品和服务范围，以及客户如何开始下一步沟通。团队规模、获奖和年限只是辅助信息，不能代替案例本身。 室内设计的完成度高度依赖图片，但页面不能只是照片集。好的结构会先给出一个判断，再用空间全景、局部细节、材料和光影去证明它。这样的页面才能同时传达审美和解决问题的能力。 这次给 AutoClaw 什么 输入不只指定了“做一份介绍”，还给出了清楚的九页叙事：封面、目录、设计理念、团队过渡、空间与材质拼贴、光影情绪、空间清单、灯具材质细节和封底。视觉方向也被限定为白底、大留白、不对称版式与暖灰木质色调。 做一个 9 页的室内设计工作室介绍稿，采用杂志画册式的极简风格，白底、大留白、左窄右宽的不对称排版；内容包含设计理念、团队、空间与材质、光影、细节和联系方式，并用九宫格展示全部页面。 AutoClaw 做了什么 首先，它把零散的素材组织成一条阅读路径：先建立风格与理念，再展开项目空间，最后回到材料、灯具和联系方式。然后，它根据每页信息量调整图片密度：理念页留白更多，空间页使用大图和拼贴，材质页收紧为统一网格。最后另做一页索引，便于快速浏览全套内容。 最终交付了什么 本次交付为 九页主内容，加一页黑底九宫格索引 。实际成品是一份约 2.9 MB 的离线 HTML，内嵌 18 张图片，可以在浏览器中直接打开和翻页，也可打印为 PDF。虽然原始需求中使用了“PPT”这个说法，但这次并没有交付可直接在 PowerPoint 中编辑的 PPTX。 如何换成自己的公司介绍 不要先追求“高级感”，先把真实资料准备齐：工作室定位、团队成员及角色、3至5个代表项目、每个项目的地点与类型、授权照片、服务范围和联系方式。向 AutoClaw 说清这份介绍要发给谁，它才能调整案例顺序：住宅客户关心居住、收纳和材料，商业客户更关心动线、展示和运营。 第一版完成后，可以继续要求“把示意图换成项目照”“把理念页改成客户能看懂的语言”“增加一页项目前后对比”。如果必须由团队在 PowerPoint 中继续改，应在交付格式中明确写出 PPTX。 发给客户前要检查什么 所有项目图片都要确认使用权，项目名称、地点、面积、完成时间和团队职责需与真实情况一致。注意删除客户隐私和未公开项目信息。最后在电脑和手机上分别预览，检查图片是否被裁切、小字是否可读、联系方式是否正确。 常见问题 室内设计公司介绍 PPT 一般几页？ 没有固定页数。首次接触用的简版可以控制在 8至12 页，只保留定位、团队、代表项目、服务和联系方式。如果是具体客户提案，则应围绕客户问题增加对应页面。 公司介绍和设计作品集有什么不同？ 公司介绍解决“你们是谁、能提供什么服务”，作品集更侧重“你们过去怎么解决过类似问题”。对小型工作室来说，两者可以合并，但不要让公司口号淹没作品。

blogs.name: 中国大模型｜Kimi 官方资讯
blogs.title: Kimi 发布游戏开发与创意工作解决方案
blogs.author: Kimi
blogs.description: 基于 Kimi K3.1 系列模型、Kimi Code 与 Kimi Work 系列 Agent 产品，以及 Unity、Unreal Engine、Blender 等专业工具插件，帮助游戏团队更快验证玩法创意、推进工程和美术制作，并将发行与运营中的玩家反馈带回下一轮迭代。
blogs.content: Kimi 发布游戏开发与创意工作解决方案 联系销售团队 下载 Kimi 桌面端 今天， Kimi 发布「游戏开发与创意工作解决方案」。 基于 Kimi K3.1 系列模型、Kimi Code 与 Kimi Work 系列 Agent 产品，以及 Unity、Unreal Engine、Blender 等专业工具插件，我们希望帮助游戏团队更快验证玩法创意、推进工程和美术制作，并将发行与运营中的玩家反馈带回下一轮迭代。 游戏创意的价值，往往要到玩家真正操作时才能判断： 策划文档能说明规则，却难以回答操作是否顺手、奖励是否明确、节奏是否吸引人。若这些问题在关卡、代码和资产大量完成后才暴露，调整就会牵动更多人和预算。 Kimi 希望帮助团队尽早做出范围明确的可玩版本，再根据真实体验决定如何投入。 游戏行业的业务挑战：更快验证，也要稳定交付 游戏开发的第一道门槛，是创意验证的成本 。 一个玩法是否有趣，需要真正玩起来才能判断。但制作原型需要投入时间和人力，团队往往只能优先验证少数想法。如何降低单次尝试的成本，在有限时间内验证更多创意？ Unity《2026 Game Development Report》 显示，52% 的受访开发者优先选择小规模项目来降低风险，67% 将原型阶段控制在三个月以内。更审慎的研发投入、更紧凑的验证周期，让原型制作效率变得更加重要。 Kimi 游戏解决方案，可以帮助游戏团队高效制作项目原型，在有限时间内探索和比较更多玩法方向，从而做出更准确的业务判断。 第二道门槛，来自跨岗位和跨工具的协作 。策划需求，需要变成工程任务；美术资产，也需要符合引擎规范。AI 若只生成一段文字或一张图，仍需要团队花大量时间进行适配和创作，才能搬进原有流程。 Kimi 解决方案可以直接衔接团队现有的工作流，操作专业工具与编辑器、修改现有工程，并交付可继续编辑的文件和清晰的操作记录，方便团队审阅、协作和推进后续工作。 Kimi 游戏开发与创意工作解决方案：从创意落地到持续迭代 Kimi 可以从团队的实际目标出发，推动创意从设想走向实践。 例如，策划想验证「在三消玩法中加入可自由组合的规则卡」是否有趣，但仅凭玩法说明，很难感受规则叠加后带来的策略变化。Kimi 会围绕这一目标，梳理规则卡的组合方式及其对消除策略、得分与反馈的影响，再将其拆解为交互、数值、界面和视听等具体制作任务，制作可试玩的原型。 这样，策划、开发和美术就能围绕同一个原型，边玩边讨论，减少创意在沟通与交接中的理解偏差。 结合模型能力与专业工具，Kimi 还可以将这种工作方式的变化，延伸到游戏开发、制作等更多环节。 模型能力与插件支持 一个游戏项目往往横跨多个团队，涉及策划文档、截图、代码、3D 资产等多种项目文件。 Kimi 可以为这一复杂流程提供支持：模型负责理解这些输入并规划、执行任务； Kimi Code 支持面向代码库中的实现和修改； Kimi Work 可以承接跨文件、跨步骤的制作任务。团队可以在这些成果的基础上继续完善，衔接后续制作流程。 针对不同团队的需求，我们也提供了覆盖日常办公、代码开发与 API 集成的系列产品，供大家选择： 此外，Kimi 还可通过插件与工具调用连接 Blender、Unity、Unreal Engine 等专业软件，直接操作现有工程，协助完成游戏开发与 3D 创作等任务。 正式立项前：用 Godot 把想法做成可试玩原型 游戏立项前，团队往往需要快速验证新玩法，但开发资源未必充足。 借助 Kimi，缺少编程经验的策划或创意团队也能在 1–2 天内做出可试玩原型。先验证玩法，再决定是否投入。 比如，团队想制作一款 2.5D 动作游戏的原型，可以提供参考图和视频，说明预期的场景氛围与玩法机制。Kimi 通过多模态能力理解参考素材中的关键视觉元素，再使用 Godot 游戏引擎搭建可试玩 Demo，呈现雨夜光影、地面积水和灯笼等场景细节，并实现挥剑、闪避和格挡等核心玩法。 制作过程中，Kimi 还可以实际运行游戏，结合渲染画面和试玩录像，检查视觉效果与功能是否达到要求。发现问题后，自主修改并重新验证，在交付前完成多轮迭代，让团队拿到的首个版本更接近预期。 有了可试玩原型，团队就能围绕实际体验展开评审：雨夜中的战斗辨识度、挥剑打击感，以及闪避与格挡的攻防体验。 团队可以据此不断调整和复测，验证核心玩法是否成立，再决定是否扩展关卡与敌人类型。 美术资产适配：让 Blender 资产从概念走向游戏场景 美术资产进入游戏场景，要经过比概念呈现更严格的检查：角色多视角是否一致，模型有无穿插，纹理和隐藏文字是否有缺陷，资源规格能否满足引擎预算。 Kimi 可以协助完成上述检查与初步调整：模型通过多模态理解，结合多视角视频与截图判断空间关系，发现并定位比例、穿插和材质问题；再将调整方案转化为脚本，借助本地 Agent 操作专业软件，完成初步修改。 通过 Blender 插件，Kimi 可以直接操作软件，协助美术团队搭建、预览和修改场景。 团队既可以提供现有工程与资产，让它完成摆放、组合和布局调整；也可以提供参考图片或视频，附上制作要求，让它从零建模、组装资产并搭建场景，还原参考中的整体形态与空间布局。 以建筑场景为例，根据美术团队提供的资产或参考图片及制作要求，Kimi 会在软件里先确定建筑的整体形态与空间布局，再逐步完善结构、材质和灯光；复杂建筑则拆分为不同构件，分步搭建与细化。搭建过程中，通过多视角预览检查模型比例、穿插与材质表现，及时发现并修正问题，提升首版交付的完成度与质量。美术团队可在此基础上继续打磨，把握最终风格与质量，将更多精力投入设计判断与细节表现，减少基础搭建和反复排查的工作量。 Kimi K3.1 Pro 使用 Blender 构建了一座机场室内雨林山谷场景，并制作了一段 17.5 秒、1920×1080 分辨率、60 fps 的 3D 建模展示视频。使用工具：Blender、Python、Geometry Nodes（几何节点）、Cycles（渲染引擎）、Pillow、NumPy 和 FFmpeg。使用的外部素材：来自 Poly Haven 的 4K HDRI 环境贴图 “Kloofendal 48d Partly Cloudy (Pure Sky)”，由 Greg Zaal 和 Jarod Guest 创作，采用 CC0 许可协议，用于天空照明和环境反射。 Kimi K3.1 Pro 在 Blender 中构建了一个可交互的、基于浏览器的 3D 体验，打造了一座大教堂的内部场景。该场景约包含 330 万个三角面，并为 8,368 个组件制作了动画效果，呈现出肋拱穹顶、石雕塑像，以及色彩鲜明的彩绘玻璃光影。使用的外部素材：来自 Poly Haven 的石材纹理（CC0 许可）；Mylius 拍摄的彩绘玻璃照片（CC BY-SA 3.0 许可）。 游戏开发：把 Agent 带入 Unity 与 Unreal Engine 的现有工程 进入正式开发后，团队面对的是已有工程、既定架构和不断变化的需求。 一个看似简单的功能，可能同时影响角色状态、界面、存档和关卡逻辑；一个完整的 3D 场景，也要兼顾空间关系、视觉效果、物理交互与运行性能。工程越复杂，模块之间的依赖越多，问题就越难定位和解决。 面对这类牵一发而动全身的工程问题，Kimi 可以在获得工程文件和必要权限后，先梳理代码结构、场景层级和模块依赖，找到真正需要修改的位置，再借助插件在 Unity、Unreal Engine 等编辑器中完成具体操作。 改动完成后，Kimi 会结合问题复现、日志和运行数据验证效果，并根据结果继续调整。交付时保留代码差异和验证记录，方便工程师检查功能、性能与兼容性。 围绕这套工作流程，我们在内部探索了几类用法： Kimi + Unity：从网页试玩走向专业开发。 可玩 Demo 只是开始，要走向正式上线，还需进一步完善工程，以支撑后续的调试、打磨与持续迭代。Kimi 模型与 Unity 中国推出的游戏开发智能体 Tuanjie Codely Agent 及 团结引擎协同 ，将需求理解、工程实现与测试迭代串联起来：Kimi 模型负责理解开发者的创作意图与游戏设计、生成实现代码，并根据录屏与测试结果分析问题、制定修改方案；Tuanjie Codely Agent 则依托与团结引擎的原生整合，通过 Editor / Runtime Script 等方式直接在引擎中执行操作，完成场景搭建、玩法实现、工程修改与运行验证。 开发流程由此从“人提需求—模型写代码—人来操作”，延伸为“模型理解与生成—Agent 操作引擎—模型分析反馈—Agent 修改工程并验证”的完整闭环，减少了开发者在工具间切换与手动操作的成本。 在一次演示中，Kimi 在没有人工干预的情况下连续工作 20 小时，不仅复现了原作，还产出了一份可持续开发的原生工程，为后续玩法扩展、画面打磨及多端适配打下基础。 Kimi + Unreal Engine：跨模块的玩法开发与联调。 游戏玩法的新增或调整，往往会同时牵动角色行为、动画、物理效果和界面反馈。开发者提供相关脚本、组件配置与预期效果后，Kimi 可以梳理各模块之间的调用关系，协助修改代码、补充日志与测试，并结合 Unreal Engine 中的实际表现进行联调。以古风武侠游戏中的“处决”玩法为例，玩家靠近敌人后，角色需要连贯完成拔剑、攻击和收剑动作，并触发后续剧情。Kimi 可以协助完成人物动作绑定、模拟处决后的物理效果、衔接战斗与剧情逻辑，排查动作错位、倒地异常或剧情未

blogs.title: Week 17 · April 20–24, 2026 - Claude Code Docs
blogs.description: /ultrareview opens as a research preview, automatic session recaps when you return to a terminal, custom color themes you can build and ship in plugins, and a redesigned Claude Code on the web.
blogs.content: What's New Week 17 · April 20–24, 2026 Copy page Copy page /ultrareview opens as a research preview, automatic session recaps when you return to a terminal, custom color themes you can build and ship in plugins, and a redesigned Claude Code on the web. Copy page Copy page Releases v2.1.114 → v2.1.119 4 features · April 20–24 /ultrareview research preview Now in public research preview. Ultrareview runs a fleet of bug-hunting agents in the cloud against your branch or a PR, and findings land back in the CLI or Desktop automatically. Run it before merging critical changes such as auth or data migrations. Review the branch you’re on: Claude Code > /ultrareview Or point it at a PR: Claude Code > /ultrareview 1234 Ultrareview guide Session recap CLI Switch focus away from a session and come back to a one-line recap of what happened while you were gone. Helpful for staying in flow while running several Claude sessions at once. Generate a recap on demand, or turn the automatic one off from /config : Claude Code > /recap Interactive mode: session recap Custom themes v2.1.118 Build and switch between named color themes from /theme , or hand-edit JSON files in ~/.claude/themes/ . Each theme picks a base preset and overrides only the tokens you care about. Plugins can ship themes too. Open the theme picker and create a new one: Claude Code > /theme Terminal config: create a custom theme Claude Code on the web web A new look for claude.ai/code that matches the redesigned desktop app: sessions sidebar, drag-and-drop layout, and a refreshed routines view. Key parts were rebuilt for quicker responses and a more reliable experience. Claude Code on the web Other wins Vim visual mode : press v for character selection or V for line selection in the prompt input, with operators and visual feedback Hooks can now call MCP tools directly via type: “mcp_tool” , so a hook can hit an already-connected server without spawning a process /cost and /stats are merged into /usage ; the old names still work as typing shortcuts that open the relevant tab /config changes (theme, editor mode, verbose, and similar) now persist to ~/.claude/settings.json and follow the same project/local/policy precedence as other settings Forked subagents can be enabled on external builds with CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=1 : a fork inherits your full conversation context instead of starting fresh Default effort level for Pro and Max subscribers on Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 is now high (was medium ) Native macOS and Linux builds replace the Glob and Grep tools with embedded bfs and ugrep available through Bash, for faster searches without a separate tool round-trip --from-pr now accepts GitLab merge request, Bitbucket pull request, and GitHub Enterprise PR URLs in addition to github.com Auto mode: include “$defaults” in autoMode.allow , soft_deny , or environment to add custom rules alongside the built-in list instead of replacing it New claude plugin tag command creates release git tags for plugins with version validation Opus 4.7 sessions now compute against the model’s native 1M context window, fixing inflated /context percentages and premature autocompaction /resume on large sessions is up to 67% faster and now offers to summarize stale, large sessions before re-reading them Full changelog for v2.1.114–v2.1.119 → Was this page helpful? blogs.title: Week 16 · April 13–17, 2026 - Claude Code Docs
blogs.description: Claude Opus 4.7 with the new xhigh effort level, Routines on Claude Code on the web, mobile push notifications that ping your phone when Claude needs you, a /usage breakdown that shows what's driving your limits, and native binaries replacing the bundled JavaScript.
blogs.content: What's New Week 16 · April 13–17, 2026 Copy page Copy page Claude Opus 4.7 with the new xhigh effort level, Routines on Claude Code on the web, mobile push notifications that ping your phone when Claude needs you, a /usage breakdown that shows what’s driving your limits, and native binaries replacing the bundled JavaScript. Copy page Copy page Releases v2.1.105 → v2.1.113 5 features · April 13–17 Claude Opus 4.7 new model Anthropic’s strongest coding model yet is now the default on Max and Team Premium, and available everywhere else from /model . It adds a new xhigh effort level that sits between high and max : best results for most coding and agentic tasks, applied as the default the first time you switch to 4.7. /effort now opens an interactive arrow-key slider when you call it without arguments, so you can dial intelligence against speed without remembering the level names. Switch model and effort in one go: Claude Code > /model opus > /effort xhigh Model config: effort levels Routines web Templated cloud agents that fire on a schedule, a GitHub event, or an API call. Define a routine once on Claude Code on the web with a prompt, the repos it can touch, and the connectors it needs, then let PR-opened, release-published, or your own webhook trigger it without your machine running. The trigger picker now covers GitHub events with optional filters and gives every routine a tokened /fire endpoint for external systems. Create one from the web UI, or scaffold from your terminal: Claude Code > /schedule daily PR review at 9am Routines guide /usage breakdown CLI More visibility into where your Claude Code usage goes. /usage now shows what’s driving your limits: parallel sessions, subagents, cache misses, and long context, each with a percentage of your last 24 hours and a tip to optimize it. Press d or w to switch between day and week views. Run it any time: Claude Code > /usage Commands reference Mobile push notifications mobile With Remote Control connected, Claude can send a push notification to your phone when a long task finishes or it needs a decision to keep going. Turn it on with “Push when Claude decides” in /config , or ask for one in your prompt. Useful when you kick off a long agent run and want to step away from the terminal. Ask Claude to ping you when it’s done: Claude Code > notify me when the tests pass Remote Control: mobile push notifications Native binaries v2.1.113 The claude CLI now spawns a native per-platform binary instead of bundled JavaScript, so the installed claude command no longer invokes Node. The npm package pulls the right binary in through an optional dependency such as @anthropic-ai/claude-code-darwin-arm64 , so your install command doesn’t change. The standalone installer already shipped this binary; npm now matches it. Upgrade and check what you’re running: claude update claude --version Setup guide Other wins New /ultrareview : comprehensive code review in the cloud using parallel multi-agent analysis and an adversarial critique pass. Run it bare to review your current branch, or /ultrareview <PR#> for a specific PR Auto mode is now available for Max subscribers on Opus 4.7, and the --enable-auto-mode flag is no longer required Session recap shows a one-line summary of what happened while you were away; run /recap on demand or turn it off from /config New /tui command and tui setting switch between classic and flicker-free rendering mid-conversation; focus view moved from Ctrl+O to its own /focus command Plugins can ship background watchers via a top-level monitors manifest key that auto-arms at session start or on skill invoke ”Auto (match terminal)” option in /theme follows your terminal’s dark/light mode /fewer-permission-prompts scans your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP calls and proposes an allowlist for .claude/settings.json Claude can now discover and run built-in commands like /init , /review , and /security-review via the Skill tool PreCompact hooks can block compaction

blogs.description: Ultraplan cloud planning, the Monitor tool with self-pacing /loop, /team-onboarding for packaging your setup, and /autofix-pr from your terminal.
blogs.content: What's New Week 15 · April 6–10, 2026 Copy page Copy page Ultraplan cloud planning, the Monitor tool with self-pacing /loop, /team-onboarding for packaging your setup, and /autofix-pr from your terminal. Copy page Copy page Releases v2.1.92 → v2.1.101 4 features · April 6–10 Ultraplan research preview Kick off plan mode in the cloud from your terminal, then review the result in your browser. Claude drafts the plan in a Claude Code on the web session while your terminal stays free; when it’s ready you comment on individual sections, ask for revisions, and choose to execute remotely or send it back to your CLI. As of v2.1.101 the first run auto-creates a default cloud environment, so there’s no web setup step before you can try it. Run the command, or just include the keyword in any prompt: Claude Code /ultraplan migrate the auth service from sessions to JWTs Ultraplan guide Monitor tool v2.1.98 A new built-in tool that spawns a background watcher and streams its events into the conversation: each event lands as a new transcript message that Claude reacts to immediately. Tail a training run, babysit a PR’s CI, or auto-fix a dev server crash the moment it happens, all without a Bash sleep loop holding the turn open. Ask Claude to watch something while you keep working: Claude Code Tail server.log in the background and tell me the moment a 5xx shows up This pairs with /loop , which now self-paces: omit the interval and Claude schedules the next tick based on the task, or reaches for the Monitor tool to skip polling altogether. Claude Code /loop check CI on my PR Monitor tool reference /autofix-pr CLI PR auto-fix landed on the web in Week 13. Now you can turn it on without leaving your terminal: /autofix-pr infers the open PR for your current branch and enables auto-fix for it on Claude Code on the web in one step. Push your branch, run the command, walk away; Claude watches CI and review comments and pushes fixes until it’s green. Run it from the PR’s branch: Claude Code /autofix-pr Auto-fix pull requests /team-onboarding v2.1.101 Generates a teammate ramp-up guide from your local Claude Code usage. Run it in a project you know well and hand the output to a new teammate so they can replay your setup instead of starting from defaults. Run it from a project you’ve spent real time in: Claude Code /team-onboarding Commands reference Other wins Focus view: press Ctrl+O in flicker-free mode to collapse the view to your last prompt, a one-line tool summary with diffstats, and Claude’s final response Guided Amazon Bedrock and Google Cloud’s Agent Platform setup wizards on the login screen: pick “3rd-party platform” for step-by-step auth, region, credential check, and model pinning /agents gets a tabbed layout: a Running tab shows live subagents with a ● N running count, plus Run agent and View running instance actions in the Library tab Default effort level is now high for API-key, Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud’s Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry, Team, and Enterprise users (control with /effort ) /cost shows a per-model and cache-hit breakdown for subscription users /release-notes is now an interactive version picker Status line: new refreshInterval setting re-runs the command every N seconds, and workspace.git_worktree in the JSON input CLAUDE_CODE_PERFORCE_MODE : Edit/Write fail on read-only files with a p4 edit hint instead of silently overwriting OS CA certificate store is now trusted by default, so enterprise TLS proxies work without extra setup ( CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE=bundled to opt out) Amazon Bedrock powered by Mantle: set CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE=1 Hardened Bash tool permissions: backslash-escaped flags, env-var prefixes, /dev/tcp redirects, and compound commands now prompt correctly UserPromptSubmit hooks can set the session title via hookSpecificOutput.sessionTitle Full changelog for v2.1.92–v2.1.101 → Was this page helpful? blogs.title: 两个 Word 文档怎么对比？AutoClaw 找出版本差异
blogs.author: AutoClaw Team
blogs.description: 把两个 Word 版本交给 AutoClaw，它可以逐条识别新增、删除和修改，核对金额、日期、对象与否定词，并交付差异表、变化摘要和复核记录。
blogs.content: 返回博客 两个 Word 文档怎么对比？AutoClaw 找出版本差异 教程 作者：AutoClaw Team 2026年10月30日 把两个 Word 版本交给 AutoClaw，它可以逐条识别新增、删除和修改，核对金额、日期、对象与否定词，并交付差异表、变化摘要和复核记录。 两个 Word 版本，AutoClaw 能帮你对比到什么程度 如果你有一份制度、合同、方案或招标文件的新旧两个版本，可以把 V1、V2 和对比要求一起交给 AutoClaw。它不只标出哪些字变了，还可以按条款理解两份文档，逐条整理新增、删除和修改，检查金额、日期、适用对象、前置条件和否定词，最后生成可以直接给团队复核的差异清单和变化摘要。 这次案例中，我们给 AutoClaw 两份虚构的《员工差旅与报销管理办法》。AutoClaw 对比后登记了 16 条差异，其中包括 13 条实质变化、2 条非实质文字调整和 1 条待确认内容，并交付一份 Excel 差异对比表、两份 Word 文档。 简单说，你不需要自己把两个 Word 并排打开、逐页寻找变化，再手工整理表格和汇报材料。AutoClaw 可以把“查差异、做清单、写摘要、再复核”放在一个任务里完成。 你提供给 AutoClaw AutoClaw 完成 最终拿到 旧版 Word 和新版 Word 按章节和条款建立对应关系 16 条版本差异 重点核对项 检查数字、日期、对象、条件和否定词 带原文和依据的差异表 使用场景 按员工影响、审批流程和执行要求归类 便于阅读的变化摘要 二次复核要求 补录遗漏、修正误判、合并冗余记录 完整复核修改记录 这次任务是怎么交给 AutoClaw 的 任务要求 AutoClaw 以 V1 到 V2 为比较方向，只依据两份原始 Word，不引入外部资料。每条差异都要保存旧版原文、新版原文、所在条款、变化类型和可能影响。 我们还特别要求它逐项核对数字、日期、适用对象和否定词。同一句话里如果同时改变两个规则，必须拆成两条记录；不能确认的内容标记为“待确认”，不能自行给出法律、税务或财务结论。 案例中的公司、制度、人员和金额均为虚构，仅用于展示 AutoClaw 如何完成文档版本对比任务。 AutoClaw 在任务里具体做了哪些工作 先判断哪些条款可以对应 新版本增加或删除条款后，后面的序号往往会整体变化。如果只把“第十二条”和“第十二条”机械对比，很容易把不同内容配在一起。 AutoClaw 先根据章节、条款名称和正文内容建立对应关系。案例中，V1 的 18 条变成 V2 的 20 条；原第九条被删除后，后续条款统一顺延。AutoClaw 将序号顺延作为删除带来的连锁结果，没有重复计算成新的业务变化。 把每一处变化整理成结构化记录 找到对应条款后，AutoClaw 将变化分为新增、删除、修改、文字调整和待确认，并为每条记录保存 V1 原文、V2 原文、变化位置、影响对象和核对说明。 最终 16 条记录中，实质变化共 13 条，包括新增 3 条、删除 1 条、修改 9 条；另有 2 条非实质文字调整和 1 条待确认内容。 重点核对最容易漏掉的细节 AutoClaw 对金额、比例、时间和适用对象逐项检查。例如，一线城市住宿上限从每人每晚 800 元调整为 900 元，二线城市从 500 元调整为 450 元；报销期限从差旅结束后 15 个工作日缩短为 10 个工作日。 适用范围也从正式员工扩大到正式员工及实习生，实习生按照相应标准的 80% 执行。这些变化如果只概括成“调整报销制度”，读者并不知道自己需要改什么。 保留否定词、例外和前置条件 文档对比中，最危险的不是漏掉一段大文字，而是漏掉一个“不”或一个例外条件。 案例中，V1 规定个人原因产生的机票改签费、退票费一律不予报销。V2 仍保留个人原因不予报销，但新增航空公司取消航班或延误超过 4 小时的例外，并要求提供航空公司证明。AutoClaw 在差异表和摘要中同时保留了限制、例外和证明要求。 一句话里有两项变化，拆成两条记录 事前审批条款在同一句中改变了两件事：提前申请从 2 个工作日变成 3 个工作日；单次差旅预算超过 8000 元时，新增分管副总裁加签。 首轮结果把整段作为一条变化，第二轮复核时，AutoClaw 按数字逐项核对要求将其拆成 D-08 和 D-09。拆开后，行政人员可以关注提前申请时间，审批负责人可以单独处理加签门槛。 生成摘要，让团队快速知道哪些变化需要行动 除了完整差异表，AutoClaw 还把变化按“对员工影响、审批流程、执行要求、文字与程序”重新组织成一份 Word 摘要。 例如，摘要直接提醒：报销窗口缩短了 5 个工作日；预算超过 8000 元需要增加审批；累计出差 15 天及以上的 300 元补贴被取消；实习生按 80% 标准执行。这样，阅读者不必先看完 16 行长表，也能知道新版本会影响什么。 完成后再跑一轮复核 AutoClaw 对照预设的 12 处变化再次检查全文。第二轮补录了 1 条数字变化，修正了 1 条影响程度，合并了 1 条冗余序号记录，并将 2 条原本待确认的内容判定为非实质文字调整。 施行日期和旧版废止安排仍被保留为待确认，因为它涉及新旧制度的时间衔接，需要人力资源部门判断。AutoClaw 没有替业务负责人下结论。 AutoClaw 最后交付了什么 交付物 包含内容 可以怎么用 版本差异对比表 Excel 16 条差异、V1 与 V2 原文、条款位置、变化类型、影响和核对说明 逐条确认差异，分配给人力、财务或业务负责人复核 版本变化摘要 Word 总体统计、对员工影响、审批流程、执行要求和行动提醒 用于内部通知、制度评审和管理层汇报 复核修改记录 Word 第二轮补录、修正、合并和待确认内容 说明结果如何被检查，保留审阅过程 这类交付比单纯的“红线对比”更接近真实工作：不仅告诉你哪里变了，也把差异整理成可以讨论、确认和传播的成品。 这类任务为什么适合交给 AutoClaw Word 版本对比通常包含大量重复阅读和整理工作：先找对应条款，再提取原文，记录金额与日期，制作差异表，最后写一份给其他人看的摘要。AutoClaw 可以连续完成这些步骤，并同时生成 Excel 和 Word。 它尤其适合制度修订、合同版本核对、方案修改、招标文件更新等需要完整差异清单和汇报材料的场景。如果你只想临时确认一小段文字有没有改动，Word 自带的比较功能可能已经足够。 可以直接复制给 AutoClaw 的任务描述 请对比我提供的两个 Word 文档，明确以旧版到新版为比较方向。先按章节标题、条款名称和正文内容建立对应关系，不要只按条款序号机械匹配。逐条登记新增、删除、修改和文字调整，完整保留旧版原文、新版原文、所在章节、变化类型和影响对象。重点逐项核对所有金额、比例、日期、期限、适用对象、前置条件和否定词；同一句中有多处数字或规则变化时必须拆分记录。请区分文本事实和影响判断，无法确定的内容标记为待确认，不要给出法律、税务或财务合规结论。输出一份 Excel 版本差异对比表、一份 Word 版本变化摘要和一份 Word 复核修改记录。完成后进行第二轮复核，写明补录、修正和合并了哪些差异。

blogs.title: Week 13 · March 23–27, 2026 - Claude Code Docs
blogs.description: Auto mode for hands-off permissions, computer use built in, PR auto-fix in the cloud, transcript search, and a PowerShell tool for Windows.
blogs.content: What's New Week 13 · March 23–27, 2026 Copy page Copy page Auto mode for hands-off permissions, computer use built in, PR auto-fix in the cloud, transcript search, and a PowerShell tool for Windows. Copy page Copy page Releases v2.1.83 → v2.1.85 6 features · March 23–27 Auto mode research preview Auto mode hands your permission prompts to a classifier. Safe edits and commands run without interrupting you; anything destructive or suspicious gets blocked and surfaced. It’s the middle ground between approving every file write and running with --dangerously-skip-permissions . Cycle to auto with Shift+Tab, or set it as your default: ~/.claude/settings.json { "permissions" : { "defaultMode" : "auto" } } Permission modes guide Computer use Desktop Claude can now control your actual desktop from the Claude Code Desktop app: open native apps, click through the iOS simulator, drive hardware control panels, and verify changes on screen. It’s off by default and asks before each action. Best for the things nothing else can reach: apps without an API, proprietary tools, anything that only exists as a GUI. Enable it in Settings, grant the OS permissions, then ask Claude to verify a change end to end: Claude Code Open the iOS simulator, tap through the onboarding flow, and screenshot each step Computer use guide PR auto-fix Web Flip a switch when you open a PR and walk away. Claude watches CI, fixes the failures, handles the nits, and pushes until it’s green. No more babysitting a PR through six rounds of lint errors. After creating a PR on Claude Code web, toggle Auto fix in the CI panel. Auto-fix pull requests Transcript search v2.1.83 Press / in transcript mode to search your conversation. n and N step through matches. Finally a way to find that one Bash command Claude ran 400 messages ago. Open transcript mode and search: Claude Code Ctrl+O # open transcript /migrate # search for "migrate" n # next match N # previous match Fullscreen guide PowerShell tool preview v2.1.84 Windows gets a native PowerShell tool alongside Bash. Claude can run cmdlets, pipe objects, and work with Windows-native paths without translating everything through Git Bash. Opt in from settings: .claude/settings.json { "env" : { "CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL" : "1" } } PowerShell tool docs Conditional hooks v2.1.85 Hooks can now declare an if field using permission rule syntax. Your pre-commit check only spawns for Bash(git commit *) instead of every bash call, cutting the process overhead on busy sessions. Scope a hook to git commits only: .claude/settings.json { "hooks" : { "PreToolUse" : [{ "hooks" : [{ "if" : "Bash(git commit *)" , "type" : "command" , "command" : ".claude/hooks/lint-staged.sh" }] }] } } Hooks reference Other wins Plugin userConfig now public: prompt for settings at enable time, keychain-backed secrets Pasted images insert [Image #N] chips you can reference positionally managed-settings.d/ drop-in directory for layered policy fragments CwdChanged and FileChanged hook events for direnv-style setups Agents can declare initialPrompt in frontmatter to auto-submit a first turn Ctrl+X Ctrl+E opens your external editor, matching readline Interrupting before any response restores your input automatically /status now works while Claude is responding Deep links open in your preferred terminal, not first-detected Idle-return nudge to /clear after 75+ minutes away VS Code: rate limit banner, Esc-twice rewind picker Full changelog for v2.1.83–v2.1.85 → Was this page helpful? blogs.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro：智能前沿，更进一步
blogs.author: Kimi
blogs.description: Kimi K3.1 Pro 正式发布：支持 100 万上下文，提升代码、3D 创作、金融研究与长程 Agent 能力；高速版同步上线。
blogs.content: Kimi K3.1 Pro：智能前沿，更进一步 更新于：2026-10-24 The only way of discovering the limits of the possible is to venture a little way past them into the impossible. 发现「可能」之极限的唯一方法，是向「不可能」的方向多走一小步。 ——阿瑟·C·克拉克《未来的轮廓》 今天，我们正式推出 Kimi K3.1 Pro ，这是 K3.1 系列的第一个模型，也是我们迄今能力最强的 3 万亿级参数模型，支持 100 万上下文。Kimi K3.1 Pro 在代码、3D 创作、金融研究和其他长程 Agent 能力上的提升尤为显著。 我们同步推出高速版模型 Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed ，同等智能，输出速度约 2~3 倍。 即日起，可通过 kimi.com 、Kimi App、 Kimi Work 、 Kimi Code 和 Kimi API ，使用 Kimi K3.1 Pro 和 Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed 模型。完整模型权重将于 11 月 4 日前发布。 完整 Benchmarks 请访问 kimi.com/blog/kimi-k3-1-pro 持续突破前沿 Kimi K3.1 Pro 是 Kimi K3 的后训练版本，后训练算力大幅增加。为了支撑数百个下游领域的大规模联合训练，我们优化了技术栈的每一层，包括 RL 框架、长上下文推理、训练效率、沙箱基础设施、调度系统，以及用于环境质量检查的共享平台等，确保每一份新增的 RL 算力都能转化为稳定、高效的回报。最终，Kimi K3.1 Pro 模型在所有领域都获得了大规模 RL 带来的全面提升。 在代码、Agent 和知识类基准上，K3.1 Pro 达到或接近最强闭源模型的水平。Terminal-Bench 4.0 通过真实环境中资源受限的终端任务考察编程智能体的能力，每项任务均设有严格的专项测试。K3.1 Pro 在此项评估中得分 65.7%，超过 GPT-6 Astra（58.2%），与 Claude Opus 5.5（66.4%）仅有微弱差距。Kimi Code Bench 3.0 Long-horizon 是我们内部的基准测试，覆盖多种工程领域，重点考察编程智能体的多步执行、工具调用和端到端问题解决能力。K3.1 Pro 在这项测试中得分 61.2%，高于 K3 的 55.95%。 代码 Kimi K3.1 Pro 能胜任各种规模的编码任务：小到在真实代码库里修复一个问题，大到从零搭建一个完整项目。它也为游戏和网页体验带来更考究的视觉风格，并且知道如何用合适的外部专业工具把它们做出来。 K3.1 Pro 能熟练使用 Unity、Unreal Engine、Godot 等游戏引擎，并结合网络搜索与 3D 生成，做出完整的体验。它产出的前端页面、Three.js 交互场景和 3D 资产，在构图、排版、动效和细节打磨上都有明显提升。以下案例均由 K3.1 Pro 端到端完成： 通过大规模强化学习，K3.1 Pro 的长程编码能力也得到了充分的增强。在一项内部测试中，K3.1 Pro 基于包含 296 个骨骼组件（含软骨）和 402 个肌肉组件的开源人体解剖学模型，构建了一套集成训练与评估流程的人类行走动力学仿真器。在进行 167 项任务、420 次独立评审的过程中，它持续分析实验结果、定位问题并迭代优化行走控制器，推动仿真人体从最初几步内便倒地，进步到能够交替迈步、连续行走 11.2 秒。当调整奖励机制仍无法改善手臂运动时，K3.1 Pro 没有停留于此，而是转而对仿真器动力学进行开环探测，实现问题定位并修正了肩部肌肉力臂计算中的 36 处错误，随后重新训练了控制器。 参与早期测试的伙伴发来了他们对 K3.1 Pro 代码能力的反馈： 我们在内测显示，Kimi K3.1 Pro 较上一代 K3 提升近 10 个百分点，综合效果进步清晰，复杂功能边界更完整，在 Qoder 当前用例样本中处于领先位置。模型能力的扎实提升，让我们对产品体验的进一步优化更有信心。 Unity 中国推出的 Tuanjie Codely 搭载 Kimi 旗舰模型，其在游戏开发场景中的代码生成能力表现出色，展现了国产模型在专业编程领域的竞争力。Kimi 的模型能力与 Tuanjie Codely 的引擎工具链相结合，帮助开发者更快构建原型、验证玩法、迭代体验，把更多时间留给创意打磨。我们期待与 Kimi 持续深化合作，让更多好点子更快成为有趣的作品。 3D建模 Kimi K3.1 Pro 模型擅长 3D 创作与空间推理。在 BenchCAD 基准测试中，K3.1 Pro 借助工具得分 92.7%，接近 Claude Opus 5.5 的 96.2% 和 GPT-6 Astra 的 95.9%。该基准考察通过生成 CAD 代码，从多视角渲染图重建 3D 模型的能力。给 K3.1 Pro 一段文字描述、一张草图或一张参考图，它能推断出物体的形状、比例和空间关系，并将其重建为可用的 3D 模型。它对现有素材库和模型库也有更强的理解。 K3.1 Pro 擅长参数化建模，例如机械零件、建筑模型、多参数可配置的产品和定制家具。无需依赖 MCP 连接器，它可以直接编写并运行 Blender、CAD 等专业建模工具的脚本，完成素材的构建与细化，修改单个部件，并调整几何、材质与场景布局。 以下案例均由 Kimi K3.1 Pro 端到端完成，可直接用于品牌宣传片、游戏和交互式网页体验： kimi.com 和 Kimi app 已同步上线 3D Make 功能，支持在线预览和编辑 3D 模型，做好的模型可以直接下载去 3D 打印，也能导出视频或实况照片，随手分享到社交平台。 金融 凭借更强的推理与工具调用能力，Kimi K3.1 Pro 能够端到端交付完整的金融工作流。在外部基准上，K3.1 Pro 在 OfficeQA Pro v2 基准测试中得分 64.4，取得当前最优成绩（SoTA）。OfficeQA Pro v2 考察基于真实金融文档的复杂财务数据分析，涉及检索、跨文档核对与多步数值推理。K3.1 Pro 在 Frontier Finance 上的表现也较 K3 进一步提升。该基准测试衡量模型对完整投资工作流的支持能力，覆盖从标的筛选到盈利分析的全过程。 在 3 个内部金融基准上，K3.1 Pro 同样全面超过 K3： 财务建模基准 Financial Modelling 考察真实建模任务中的公式联动、财务逻辑与最终工作簿质量，K3.1 Pro 较 K3 提高 14%。 金融研究基准 Financial Research 用于检验模型能否完成真实场景下的金融研究工作，并在证据与截止条件约束下输出可核验的结果。K3.1 为较 K3 提升 20%。 商业运营基准 Business Operation 在模拟商业环境中考察长程经营管理与决策能力，K3.1 Pro 得分约为 K3 的 4.2 倍。 以下案例展示了 K3.1 Pro 在实践中如何处理财务建模、投资分析与基于真实来源的研究工作： 金融分析和投资研究对事实准确性有很高要求。为此，我们针对高难度真实工作场景和高难度提示词，对 K3.1 Pro 的事实准确性进行了专项优化。Kimi Hallu Bench Hard 是一项专门针对事实准确性开展的内部压力测试。在该测试中，新模型的单项事实陈述错误率从 K3 的 23.4% 降至 8.3%；包含至少一处事实错误的回答比例仅为前代的约 42.4%。（这是一项针对事实准确性的压力测试，样本刻意聚焦模型容易出错的情形，所报告的错误率不代表日常使用中的整体水平。） 参与早期测试的伙伴发来了他们对 K3.1 Pro 金融能力的反馈： 我们在内测中发现，Kimi K3.1 Pro 在 Office 场景比肩前沿模型，较上一代有大幅提升，任务规划、执行与自测闭环明显增强。配合 WorkBuddy 的 Agent 编排能力，复杂任务真正实现从材料到交付的端到端自动化。 熵简的机构用户要的不只是快，更是准。我们对 12 个国内外头部模型进行了金融投研 Agent 场景评测，Kimi 是目前唯一能在该场景下平替海外旗舰模型的国产大模型。Kimi K3.1 Pro 在长文档问答和数据引用上的准确率位居前二；此前 K3 模型接入熵简 AlphaEngine 产品后，用户采纳率提升了 20%。AI 投研正在从问答走向 Agent，底座模型迭代得快，我们的产品才能触达更高的智能天花板。 大模型正在改变资产管理的知识生产方式和组织本身。过去的AI更多是回答一个问题，未来的AI将更深入的参加完整研究和组织运营。Kimi K3.1 Pro 的长程 Agent 能力让我们离这一目标更近了一步。华夏基金（香港）以 Kimi 旗舰大模型为自研 Agent 底座，Kimi
